units.function: Database-backed and pure tests for interactive custom-image setup, capture/promotion/replacement/rollback/disable, expiry cleanup, runtime template binding, base-config fingerprints and save-time reconciliation.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest -> custom-image/environment runtime services -> Drizzle/Postgres and mocked plugin worker; pure fingerprint helpers run independently, while actual sandbox provider, Secret resolver and execution node are not exercised.
units.keyDataModels: Environment, plugin manifest/driver declaration, setup session/provider lease/connection summary, custom-image template/source fingerprint/status/lineage, runtime config binding, identity/excluded paths and user/Agent creator attribution.
units.lifecycle: Create expiring interactive provider session -> refresh provider state -> capture immutable provider template -> promote and supersede prior active template -> apply only when provider/base identity matches -> re-link non-identity config changes or detach identity changes -> rollback/revoke/delete -> time out abandoned sessions.
units.testAssessment: Both sandboxed and approved unsandboxed focused runs passed 3 pure tests and skipped all 12 embedded-Postgres tests. The source specifies broad lifecycle and reconciliation intent, but local evidence does not execute its database/plugin state transitions. Missing adversarial coverage includes concurrent promotion/rollback/cleanup, provider timeout/crash/partial success, database constraint conflicts, replay/idempotency, cross-company Secret context, actor integrity and stored-reference classification.
units.designRationale: Preserve expensive reusable images across harmless runtime-setting edits while preventing a capture from masking an explicitly changed base image, provider endpoint or binding field; encapsulate provider differences in manifest-declared identity and binding metadata.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs governed, portable execution-image versions whose exact provenance and applicability remain stable across Connector runs, configuration edits, managed/local nodes and provider replacement.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT provider-declared template binding and identity paths plus explicit capture state/reconciliation. Make a single resolved execution-profile projection canonical for test/save/run; require schema-reviewed identity declarations, content digest, source/base digest, SBOM/signature/scanner policy, Secret/data contamination checks, transactional outbox/saga recovery, single-active constraints and responsibility/approval evidence.
units.responsibilityConflict: A user or Agent can be recorded as creator, but template promotion/rollback/deletion is not bound to an accountable human, approved change purpose, data/tool scope or acceptance evidence. A captured image can embody durable code/data side effects beyond the setup session, so attribution alone is insufficient.
evidence: 2026-08-19 sandboxed focused Vitest: 3/3 pure tests passed; 12 embedded-Postgres tests skipped
2026-08-19 approved unsandboxed focused Vitest: 3/3 pure tests passed; 12 embedded-Postgres tests skipped
units.securityFindings: HIGH unverified state-machine gap: all twelve database lifecycle tests skip on this host. HIGH supply-chain gap: capture identity lacks tested image digest, SBOM/signature/scanner/provenance and contamination controls. HIGH responsibility gap: durable promotion/rollback/delete lacks approval and accountable-human binding. HIGH secret/data classification gap: provider lease/template/source references are persisted as ordinary strings and credential exclusion assumes credentials cannot affect captured content. MEDIUM manifest-trust/caller gap: plugin-declared identity paths and applyCustomImageTemplate callers determine whether the correct image executes.
